label: lexeme sense for word in field of usage
description: String-to-sense lookup driven by Wikidata: among the lexemes in the given language that have a sense with the given 'field of usage' (P9488) item, finds the one whose first lemma is the given word and returns that sense. Built on Z6830 (Wikidata's sense-statement search), so the set of recognised words is whatever Wikidata tags with that field of usage; no word table is hard-coded.
summary: New function: lexeme sense for word in field of usage
